statBlock.name: Peryton
statBlock.description: A winged predator with a fanged stag's head dives on travelers. Its shadow has a humanoid outline.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and Elvish. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach provokes no Opportunity Attack from that enemy.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Gore attack and one Talons attack.
Gore. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Deal an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage if the peryton moved at least 30 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
Talons. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this attack dies as the peryton takes its heart.
sections.Peryton superstitions:
Roll 1d4 or choose what the peryton expects after collecting enough hearts.
1. The hearts will grant a wicked wish.
2. The peryton will regain its former shape.
3. Each heart will hatch a peryton.
4. The collection will open a portal into the Lower Planes.

statBlock.name: Lamia
statBlock.description: A lion-bodied fiend searches desert ruins for magic and uses illusions and dangerous bargains to recruit servants.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The lamia can use Corrupting Touch in place of one Claw attack.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Corrupting Touch. One creature the lamia can see within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage and is cursed for 1 hour. It is Charmed and Poisoned while the curse lasts.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 13) without Material components.
At will. Disguise Self (the disguise can be a Large or Medium biped) and Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Geas, Major Image, and Scrying.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.
sections.Lamia pacts:
Roll 1d6 or choose a demand.
1. Bring back a possession of a noble or ruler.
2. Survey and map a ruin or dungeon.
3. Help the lamia through the gates of a nearby settlement.
4. Leave a peculiar idol at a chosen site or home.
5. Lift a magic item's curse and bring the item back.
6. Kill a monster and bring back a specific organ.

statBlock.name: Harpy
statBlock.description: A winged scavenger with a humanlike face uses a magical song to draw prey into danger.

sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.
Luring Song. The harpy starts a magical song that continues while it maintains Concentration. At the start of the song, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-ft. Emanation from the harpy makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. A creature that fails is Charmed until the song ends or it succeeds on a repeat save. While Charmed by the song, the creature is Incapacitated and ignores other harpies' Luring Songs. If it is more than 5 ft. away on its turn, it follows the most direct route toward the harpy, trying to get within 5 ft. It does not avoid Opportunity Attacks for this movement. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, before entering damaging terrain, and whenever a source other than the harpy damages it. A successful save grants immunity to this harpy's song for 24 hours.

statBlock.name: Succubus
statBlock.description: A shape-shifting fiend gains leverage by impersonating people its targets trust and drains the life of those it charms.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, and Infernal. Telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Traits: Incubus Form. After finishing a Long Rest, the succubus can take Incubus form and switch to the Incubus stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Fiendish Touch attack and use either Charm or Draining Kiss.
Fiendish Touch. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 16 (2d10 + 5) psychic damage.
Charm. Cast Dominate Person at level 8 without components, using Charisma (save DC 15).
Draining Kiss. One creature within 5 ft. that the succubus has Charmed makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage, or half that on a success. The damage dealt also reduces the target's maximum HP by the same amount.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. The succubus can look like a Medium or Small Humanoid or take its true form again. Only its true form has a Fly Speed. Other statistics stay the same, and gear keeps its shape.
sections.Succubus temptations:
Roll 1d6 or choose a tactic.
1. Impersonate a loved one the target has lost.
2. Charm someone the target trusts.
3. Separate the target from family or friends.
4. Arrange a piece of unexpected good fortune.
5. Pass as an eager subordinate who flatters the target.
6. Pose as someone the target wants to protect.

statBlock.name: Pixie
statBlock.description: A tiny winged explorer uses dust and illusions to slip away from trouble.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The pixie has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Faerie Dust. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 1 radiant damage. The pixie chooses whether the target becomes Charmed or Poisoned until the start of the pixie's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 12) without Material components.
At will. Dancing Lights, Druidcraft, and Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Detect Thoughts, Fly, and Sleep.
